column1: # kernel32.dll exports and whether ReactOS 0.4.16 (x86, reports NT 5.2) has them.
# Source: the export tables of \reactos\system32\kernel32.dll and kernel32_vista.dll
# inside the released ReactOS-0.4.16-i386 image, read with pefile. Not documentation:
# these are the bytes the target actually ships. Format: name<TAB>reactos|no<TAB>where
# Names come from that image plus every name in kernel32-exports.tsv, so a function
# XP has and ReactOS lacks appears here as absent rather than simply missing.
# kernel32_vista.dll is marked absent on purpose: it is an internal ReactOS module,
# imported in that image only by ReactOS's own DLLs, never by an application.
